beats.text: Seven feet tall. A dog's head on a man's body. A howl like a human scream. That's the Michigan Dogman.
beats.label: NORTHERN MICHIGAN

beats.text: The legend says lumberjacks first met it in Wexford County in 1887, and that it comes back every ten years, in years ending in 7.
beats.label: THE LEGEND

beats.text: Here's the twist. The story comes from a song.
beats.label: THE TWIST

beats.text: On April Fools' Day, 1987, Traverse City radio station WTCM aired a song called The Legend, written by disc jockey Steve Cook. He has said he made it up as a prank.
beats.label: APRIL FOOLS' DAY, 1987

beats.text: Then the phones rang. Listeners called the station to say they had seen one.
beats.label: THE CALLS

beats.text: Cook has used the song to raise money for animal charities. And the legend says the Dogman returns in years ending in 7.
beats.label: YEARS ENDING IN 7

beats.text: Next year is 2027. Comment your town, and it could be next.

end_card.pill: A legend, born on the radio in 1987
